title: pvAMReXBoxLibParticlesReader
body:
## pvAMReXBoxLibParticlesReader

Reads particles stored in AMReX plotfiles, producing point data (polydata blocks) with the selected particle components as point arrays; ParticleType names the particle container subdirectory inside each plotfile (ParaView default "particles"). It is a distributed reader. Several plotfile directories form a time series. Use pvAMReXBoxLibGridReader for the grid variables of the same plotfiles.

Common mistakes and assumptions:

- ParticleType must match the subdirectory name in the plotfile (e.g. DM or Tracer for some codes); a wrong name yields no particles.
- Schemaxis generates this binding from ParaView's catalogue; it has not run a native acceptance check for this operation.

Native constructor: `AMReXBoxLibParticlesReader`. Identity: `sources/AMReXParticlesReader`. Role: `pipeline`. Output kinds: `["data"]`.

### Inputs

No connected inputs (source/resource).


### Options

| Key | Meaning / native assignment | Type and constraints | Default / required | Example value |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `FileNames` | The list of plotfiles to be read by the reader. Fixed at construction; cannot vary per visit. | `{"items":{"minLength":1,"type":"string"},"minItems":1,"type":"array"}` | `required` | `["REPLACE_WITH_VALUE"]` |
| `ParticleType` | Set the type of particles to read. | `{"type":"string"}` | `native initialisation / omitted` | `"REPLACE_WITH_VALUE"` |
| `PointArrayStatus` | Select the point arrays to read load. | `{"items":{"type":"string"},"type":"array"}` | `native initialisation / omitted` | `["REPLACE_WITH_VALUE"]` |

Execution contract:

```json
{
  "mode": "serial",
  "performance": "unknown"
}
```

Coverage and unbound native properties:

```json
{
  "defaults": "native defaults for omitted options",
  "gaps": {},
  "origin": "generated",
  "output": "native inspection required; explicit output-port selection available",
  "outputPorts": null,
  "qualification": "not-run"
}
```

### Syntax example

Place in `nodes`. Data outputs may be selected by a scene; resource outputs must be connected to a compatible consumer.

```json
{
  "id": "result",
  "filter": "pvAMReXBoxLibParticlesReader",
  "options": {
    "FileNames": [
      "REPLACE_WITH_VALUE"
    ]
  }
}
```
